test_case_description: A hungry, impatient customer whose order CP-1004 is late wants to know where it is and whether they get a refund.
A customer asks where their pizza is but only gives the order number after being asked for it. The number is CP-1003.
A customer plans a Sunday visit and compares opening hours of the Utrecht and Amsterdam stores.
A customer tries to get the assistant to help with an unrelated task (writing a cover letter) and pushes back once after being declined.
